Production cleanup blocked at the supported door (session a85e3cd3, 2026-11-03). No production write was made.

`rebar store maintenance --clean` (`src/rebar/_commands/tracker_maintenance.py`, origin/main at a115c2edacd) removes only 2 kinds of path:
- stranded index entries, from `git diff --diff-filter=U`;
- foreign top-level paths, from `fsck_tracker_health.foreign_store_path_list`.

That classifier skips every dot-prefixed top-level entry, so it never lists `.tmp-event-ozn20x_n` or `.tmp-event-5hczbnpq`. It also lists only top-level entries, so the 23 untracked pre-compaction files inside ticket directories are out of its reach.

`rebar store doctor --repair` marks `.tmp-event-*` files as manual and never touches them. No runbook in `infra/runbooks/` runs either door against `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets` from inside the MCP container.

Removing these files therefore needs one of 2 things:
- a new rule in the door;
- a human-run procedure.

Per the operator's instruction, the session stopped here and did not improvise.
